item.description:
Needle 0.5.0

  • Library discovers existing recordings in your Needle folder, including CLI downloads.
  • Refresh after adding files outside the app, with no duplicate entries.
  • Read embedded tags and artwork while preserving existing files and Spotify status.

This release is unsigned and not notarized. macOS may require Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

Needle 0.4.1

  • Drop source links onto any tab to add them to Review Queue and find candidates automatically.
  • Preview the recording and check detected artist/title before approving the download.
  • Drop multiple links together, with duplicate filtering and clear feedback.

This release is unsigned and not notarized. macOS may require Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

Needle 0.3.0

  • Review Queue: paste lists, approve each recording, and keep reviewing while downloads continue.
  • Smarter previews: full-track scrubbing, intro skipping, and timestamp comparison between candidates.
  • Library Repair: fix tags and embed artwork without downloading again, with original-file backups.
  • Guides in every tab: click ? for instructions and troubleshooting.

This app is unsigned. macOS may require Privacy & Security → Open Anyway after updating. Your music and settings stay on your computer.
